messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the demonstrated action in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's current action to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the demonstration in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on the road, shifts weight, turns slightly to the side, and crosses his arms in front of his chest.","camera":"Static medium-long shot from behind the character at roughly waist-to-head height.","clothing":"Light plaid long-sleeve shirt with brown leather suspenders, dark plaid pants with a rip at the back knee, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a high top-knot bun.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, shown from behind with a partially visible tanned face.","scene":"An outdoor paved road under a blue sky, with a street lamp, guardrail, and autumn-colored trees in the background."},"uncertain":["Exact facial features are mostly hidden because the character is viewed from behind."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's dancing motion with a calmer standing sequence: the character shifts weight, turns slightly, and crosses arms in front of the chest, resembling the reference's thoughtful standing pose. The character's blue hair, plaid shirt, suspenders, pants, road scene, lighting, and rear camera framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action from dancing to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the motion reference, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the final pose exactly matches the reference's demonstrated thoughtful pose, since the reference motion is only partially visible and the character is viewed from behind.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly tighter or cropped compared with the source, though the overall camera angle remains similar.
